description: Search U.S. DOL Form M-1 filings — the federal report filed by multiple employer welfare arrangements (MEWAs) and association health plans (AHPs) that pool health coverage across unrelated employers. Filter by plan year, MEWA/plan name, sponsor name, EIN, headquarters state, state(s) where the plan offers coverage, filing type, and whether it carries stop-loss coverage or is fully insured. Returns the total match count first, then up to `limit` filings with MEWA name, EIN, headquarters state, plan year, filing date, administrator and sponsor. Complements `form5500` (annual plan financial/participant returns) and `ebsa` (EBSA's own civil-penalty enforcement record) — this is neither of those, it is the MEWA registration/compliance filing itself.

coverage_state.description: Two-letter state code of a state where the MEWA offers coverage — distinct from hq_state; a MEWA can be headquartered elsewhere and still cover this state.

ein.description: MEWA Employer Identification Number (9 digits, dashes optional). Exact match.

filing_type.description: Type of Form M-1 filing. Omit for all types.

fully_insured.description: Restrict to MEWAs that are (true) or are not (false) fully insured. Omit for either.

has_stop_loss.description: Restrict to MEWAs that do (true) or do not (false) carry stop-loss coverage. Omit for either.

hq_state.description: Two-letter state code of the MEWA's headquarters (e.g. "TX").

mewa_name.description: Name of the MEWA or association health plan. Substring match.

plan_year.description: Plan year of the filing, e.g. 2024. Omit for all years (2003-2025).

sponsor.description: Name of the plan sponsor. Substring match.

name: dol_m1_search
title: Dol M1 Search
